text: AI is changing how we think about creativity. Today, AI tools can create art, compose music, and even write stories or articles. Some people are amazed by this, while others worry that machines might replace human artists. However, AI and human creativity are quite different. AI learns from existing data and produces new content based on patterns, but it does not have feelings, personal experiences, or true imagination. Humans create from emotion, memory, and intention. Perhaps the best results come when people and AI work together, using technology as a tool to support and inspire human ideas.
